name: video-analysis
description: Analyze supplied videos and audio through timestamped frames, adaptive inspection, transcripts and explicit evidence/coverage limits. By Lex from SigmaStudioz.

interface.longDescription: For video editors, designers and researchers who need to understand supplied video or audio. Request a timestamped summary, scene breakdown, tutorial walkthrough, comparison or visual and sound evidence report. The skill guides frame selection, audio inspection and coverage notes using tools available in your host. An optional local sampler requires separately installed Python, FFmpeg and ffprobe; it extracts frames and metadata but does not transcribe speech. Results depend on the media and tools available and may cover only part of a recording. No publisher-hosted service is required.
